title: H. Sum of Digits of Sums
statement:
You are given an array [a_1, a_2, …, a_n], consisting of positive integers.

For every i from 1 to n, calculate ∑ limits_{j=1}^n F(a_i + a_j), where F(x) is the sum of digits of x.

The first line contains one integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5).

The second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (1 ≤ a_i < 10^9).

Print n integers. The i-th of them should be equal to ∑ limits_{j=1}^n F(a_i + a_j).

Input:
```
4
1 3 3 7
```

Output:
```
18 17 17 15 
```

Input:
```
3
42 1337 999
```

Output:
```
38 53 47 
```
input:
The first line contains one integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5).

The second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (1 ≤ a_i < 10^9).
